memory_candidates.content: When a migrated duplicate record's disposition text defers an open question to a foreign repository's record number that no longer resolves after migration, check whether the receiving repository's own governing pattern document (e.g. cross-repo-task-migration.md's 'Duplicates: transplant before abandoning' section) already states the general rule unconditionally. A rule phrased as 'if X is not possible, do Y' does not need a separate record to resolve a specific instance of X -- it already covers it.

Two records can agree on code-level behavior (a field being null is handled safely) while disagreeing on a narrower documentation-completeness question (whether that null case is stated explicitly in the contract text, the way a sibling field's null case is). Treating 'confirmed correct on inspection, no issue here' as closing a sibling question about explicit documentation conflates safety with completeness; check whether the actual sentence the other record asked for was ever written before treating the question as settled.
